title: (feat) O3-5823: Capture diagnosis rank and certainty in the visit note
body:
## Requirements

- [x] This PR has a title that briefly describes the work done including the ticket number. If there is a ticket, make sure your PR title includes a [conventional commit](https://o3-docs.openmrs.org/en-US/docs/frontend-modules/contributing/#contributing-guidelines) label. See existing PR titles for inspiration.
- [x] My work is based on designs, which are linked or shown either in the Jira ticket or the description below. (See also: [Styleguide](http://om.rs/o3ui))
- [x] My work includes tests or is validated by existing tests.

## Summary

The visit note form previously hardcoded `certainty: 'PROVISIONAL'` on every diagnosis it saved, and encoded rank in which of two search boxes (primary/secondary) the clinician typed into. Neither rank nor certainty was ever an explicit clinical choice, and neither was visible anywhere after saving.

This PR makes both values deliberate on entry. Certainty also shows in the visits table through the styleguide's `DiagnosisTags` (openmrs/openmrs-esm-core#1881). The design follows the discussion on [Talk](https://talk.openmrs.org/t/50125):

- **One diagnosis search box** replaces the primary/secondary pair. Each added diagnosis renders as a single row — **Primary checkbox → name → ⋯ actions → remove** — under a "Primary" column header. New diagnoses appear at the top. When a note is opened for editing, stored primaries are sorted first once; after that rows stay where they are, so toggling Primary never moves a row out from under the pointer.
- **Confirmed by default; no auto-primary.** Certainty is changed through the row's ⋯ menu ("Mark as provisional" / "Mark as confirmed"), and a provisional diagnosis shows a leading "?". Primary is never pre-ticked, so the clinical choice stays explicit. The helper text states the default: "Diagnoses are recorded as confirmed unless marked provisional."
- **The certainty action is offered only for diagnosis-class concepts.** Concepts picked from the search already qualify (the search is filtered to the configured `diagnosisConceptClass`). When a note is opened for editing, the classes of its coded diagnoses are fetched in a single `conceptreferences` request (`useDiagnosisConceptClasses`, cached), so Symptom/Finding-class concepts recorded by other forms keep their stored certainty and "?" but get no ⋯. Free-text diagnoses keep the action. While the lookup is pending the action is withheld; if it fails — or the endpoint omits a reference — the action is kept rather than stranding a stored provisional diagnosis.
- **Primary-required validation** (`isPrimaryDiagnosisRequired`, default on) is validated at the group level and rendered once beneath the diagnosis list: a live warning (Carbon's `WarningAltFilled`) as soon as diagnoses exist without a primary, turning into an error (`WarningFilled`, red, `role="alert"`) once a save has been blocked by it. It clears the moment Primary is ticked, and a blocked save focuses the topmost Primary checkbox (or the search input when nothing is selected). Every Primary checkbox is described by that message via `aria-describedby`, and on tablets the checkbox has a 32px touch target matching the actions beside it.
- **Editing pre-selects stored values.** Rank or certainty values outside the known enums (possible from other REST writers) fall back to secondary/confirmed rather than being silently rewritten; a missing certainty is displayed as confirmed (`mapEncounter` defaults it), matching the form's presumption rather than the old `'PROVISIONAL'` fallback. Previously, diagnoses with rank outside {1,2} were silently *deleted* on edit. Non-coded diagnoses now survive the edit round-trip, and rows are keyed by a client-side draft id so duplicate concepts or non-coded entries no longer collide.
- **Visit-level data**: the visits-widget representation now fetches `certainty`, and `dedupeDiagnoses` merges duplicates across a visit's encounters with documented, order-independent rules — rank = mi
